Experiment 1
Fill the burette with the solution M of potassium manganate(VII) to the 0.0 cm mark. Using a
measuring cylinder pour 25 cm of solution L into the conical flask.
Add 1 cm of the solution M to the flask, with swirling. Continue to add solution M to the flask
until the mixture just turns permanently pink. Record the burette readings in the table and
complete the table.
Pour away the contents of the conical fl ask and rinse the fl ask with distilled water.
